lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: I'm switching to my left hand.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: All my molecules are left-handed. I'm matching them.

lines.speaker: fern
lines.text: Only the protein ones are left-handed.

lines.speaker: fern
lines.text: The sugars in your DNA are right-handed.

lines.speaker: fern
lines.text: They're mirror-image shapes. Like left and right gloves.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Why did my body pick both?

lines.speaker: fern
lines.text: Nobody knows why life picked that combination.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: So which hand holds the toast?

lines.speaker: fern
lines.text: The one not dropping it, Otto.
